The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
//_comment_speed: HARDENED TIMING: Hardcode period to 11.64ns to natively support 24x master crystal multiplier (85.91 MHz)
//: W_VERILOG_OPTIONS - Passing -noattr strips backslashes, while -nodec forces Yosys to expand vector array ports into independent, flat wire nodes. This stops Workcraft from crashing without altering your hierarchical module structures
SYNTH_STRATEGY - changing this option over to an area or raw delay strategy rewrites ABC's optimization profile, completely stripping out the crashing sequential timing sub-commands (like scorr)!
SYNTH_ABC_BUFFERING - Explicitly disables late combinational resizing hooks so ABC passes the gate netlist down to OpenROAD without trying to apply sequential constraints.
SYNTH_SIZING - Enables aggressive pre-placement cell sizing to scale up internal logic gates to high-performance variations early.
SYNTH_FLATTEN - Disable global flattening to preserve submodule boundaries for physical macro bounding and hierarchical power grid connection
SYNTH_FLAT_TOP - Disable global flattening to preserve submodule boundaries for physical macro bounding and hierarchical power grid connection
SYNTH_HIERARCHICAL - Force hierarchical synthesis to retain structural instance blocks so OpenROAD placement engines can identify the fence constraint target

SYNTH_HIERARCHY_MODE - Flattening unrolls vector arrays and module contexts into standalone primitives, removing illegal indexing brackets from the post-synthesis netlist ports for Workcraft compatibility
SYNTH_WRITE_NOATTR - Stripping compiler attributes removes internal Yosys properties, which cleans up backslash-escaped structural node names that crash the Workcraft token engine

SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES - Dictates whether Yosys forces resource sharing by actively identifying matching algebraic sub-expressions (like duplicated multiplexers or address decoders) and merging them into unified gate networks. For purely combinational macros, leaving this enabled or disabled changes area footprint without breaking function.
ASYNCHRONOUS LOOP & GATES PROTECTION (RESTORED UPPERCASE)
SYNTH_DONT_TOUCH - Seals the async filter module boundary so external routing doesn't get messed up.
MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT - Sets a matching high fanout ceiling for the front-end ABC logic mapping tool pass.

SYNTH_PARAMETERS - Passes top-level elaboration flags to Yosys to explicitly preserve the hierarchical structural boundaries of internal submodules like clock_synchronizer during physical gate mapping.

ERROR_ON_SYNTH_CHECKS - The updated keyword! This precisely commands the YosysSynthChecks linter pass to treat your purposeful clockless feedback loops as expected asynchronous layout warnings, allowing the pipeline to advance smoothly.
ERROR_ON_UNMAPPED_CELLS - Set to false to act as a fallback safety guardrail in case Yosys attempts to infer any sequential logic out of your stripped loops.
EXTRA_FLOORPLAN_TCL - Forces OpenROAD to execute raw Tcl commands during the floorplan pass, guaranteeing fence allocation before cells are evaluated

PL_MIN_PHI_COEFFICIENT - Sets a high initial density penalty baseline. This forces the placer to cluster your 406 asynchronous feedback loops tightly together right away, keeping wire links short to minimize routing delays.

PL_MAX_PHI_COEFFICIENT - Limits the maximum density packing penalty. This prevents the placement engine from aggressively spreading out your custom cells during cell legalization, preserving your compact layout arrangement.
PL_REGIONS - Binds the entire unflattened u_c061618g2 macro logic block inside a strict physical coordinate bounding box on the Tiny Tapeout wrapper grid without needing a hard GDS database.
FP_CORE_UTIL - Force LibreLane to generate a much larger dynamic box for our 3% cell logic by lowering core utilization
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
//1: Master boolean activation switch that turns on the placement-stage timing repair tool block, instructing OpenROAD to actively resize logic gates and patch setup violations before routing begins.
//2: Forces the placement-stage timing repair tool to treat your target clock window as 60 picoseconds tighter, driving it to upgrade your output path buffers to clear the remaining 25ps deficit legally under the Tiny Tapeout hardware specifications.
//: RUN_POST_GPL_DESIGN_REPAIR - Explicitly bars OpenROAD from altering your custom combinational cell structures or feedback nets to clear virtual setup margins.
RUN_POST_CTS_RESIZER_TIMING - Turns off timing-driven placement optimization loops globally inside the RePlAce engine profile.
RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING - Stops the global routing pass optimizer from attempting to resize your cell gates across your module boundaries.

PL_RESIZER_HOLD_MAX_BUFFER_PCT - Drops your hold fixing area allowance directly down to 0. This structurally forbids the OpenROAD resizer script from inserting delay buffers into your clockless macro wires, preserving your 100% pure asynchronous delays!
PHYSICAL ROUTER & REPAIR BYPASSES (CRITICAL FOR CAPACITIVE LOADS)
//1: Enables the late-stage global routing optimization loop, allowing OpenLane to drop heavy repeater buffers outside your frozen hierarchy boxes to patch the remaining 25ps deficit.
//2: Over-constrains the global router by 50 picoseconds to force the engine to select high-current driving cells for your external uo_out pin connections.
//: RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR - Force physical cell legalisation and track repair after global routing to resolve severe hold violations
CELL_PAD - Increase cell padding to force the tool to leave empty space around every single logic gate
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.

DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_WIRE_LENGTH - THE FINAL FIX: Setting this explicitly to 0 tells LibreLane's physical design repair engine to completely skip maximum wire length buffering, ensuring clockless loops stay 100% pure wire tracks.
